newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks flat, big buyers on sidelines.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks flat, big buyers on sidelines.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were unchanged in early Monday trade as investors kept to the sidelines, either waiting to see if the index had bottomed out or frustrated by the scarcity of selected stocks, brokers said.
The all share index was 0.09 points higher at the mid-morning break.
"Morning trade has been mainly retail investor-driven," said Subram Ramaswamy, deputy general manager of Bartleet Mallory Stock Brokers.
Institutional investors either could not secure quantities of finance, manufacturing and conglomerate shares or were waiting to see if the index would fall further, he said.
Turnover was 5.2 million rupees, and brokers said final volumes would not improve unless investors were able to source significant quantities of stock.
